title: Bring regret under mercy, not despair
summary: Let mercy and grace reach the heart before effort strains. Do not let the day outrun this: let this stay with you: regret quiets when the heart returns the moment to Hukam.
lifeApplication: When the old mistake returns, stop before turning it into an identity. Bring the regret under God's Name and ask what faithfulness looks like now.

source.shortMeaning: Past actions remain real, but mercy and the Name are still larger.
source.lifeApplication: When regret revisits, take refuge in the Name before self-condemnation expands.
